summary.text: Malcolm Augustine is the Democratic state senator for Maryland District 47, in office since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has been Senate president pro tempore since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Augustine lives in Prince George's County, Maryland, and his career experience includes working as director of business development with Intra-Mail Network.

He took office in the Senate in January 2019 as the successor to Victor Ramirez, and in the 2025-2026 term he serves on the Children, Youth, and Families, Education, Health & Environmental Affairs, and Executive Nominations committees.
He advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
